title: Higher-spin composites and emergent AdS$_3$ geometry in the $(1+1)$-dimensional Gross-Neveu model
summary: We study the $(1+1)$-dimensional Gross-Neveu (GN) model with $N$ fermion species and derive from it an emergent AdS$_3$ geometry together with the leading entries of a holographic dictionary. We use a Bargmann-Wigner fusion scheme to generate an infinite tower of higher-spin composite fields from fundamental fermions and study their relative dynamics. A key feature is that the competition between spin-0 (chiral) condensation and spin-1 pairing defines the radial coordinate $z$ of the bulk geometry.
